description: This header file declares the 'DbusMgr' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class provides methods for managing and accessing various NetworkManager-related proxies and connections through D-Bus, facilitating network management functionalities.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class managing D-Bus proxies and connections for NetworkManager interactions, providing various getter methods to retrieve proxies for different network components.

methods.name: DbusMgr
methods.description: Constructor for the DbusMgr class, initializes the D-Bus connection and proxies.

methods.name: ~DbusMgr
methods.description: Destructor for the DbusMgr class, responsible for cleanup.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for the main NetworkManager interface.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for NetworkManager settings.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a specific network connection, given its connection path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a specified network device.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for wireless network devices.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for IPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for IPv6 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for active network connections.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for access points.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for network device properties.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for DHCPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for DHCPv6 configuration.
